title: Associated module complexes on an arbitrary affine scheme
statement: Let $Y$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and put $A=\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$. Define the functor from cochain complexes of $A$-modules to cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules by termwise associated sheaf on $\operatorname{Spec} A$ followed by termwise pushforward along the inverse of the canonical isomorphism $Y\cong\operatorname{Spec} A$. It sends differentials by the same composite functor.
